hypotheses_validated.claim: ctypes HearthOptions/HearthModelInfo/HearthStats match engine/include/hearth.h field for field (name, order, type, offset, size).
hypotheses_validated.evidence: test_ctypes_structs_match_header (regex parse of hearth.h) and test_engine_against_compiled_abi_stub (MSVC-compiled stub reports sizeof/offsetof of every field, generated from the header) both pass; on a scratch copy each test killed 5/5 layout mutants (cache_gb float, swapped hits/misses, eos_ids[7], dropped verbose, pin_fraction double), control passed.

hypotheses_validated.claim: Greedy prompt-lookup speculative decoding is token-for-token identical to plain greedy decoding, given an engine whose batched eval equals sequential eval (INV-DET-2).
hypotheses_validated.evidence: test_speculative_greedy_is_lossless (12 seeds x 5 prompts x 3 draft configs x 2 FakeEngine regimes incl. frequent rejections), stop-token / repetition-penalty / KV-capacity variants, and the compiled C stub through real ctypes (generation to the KV limit, 157 accepted drafts).

hypotheses_validated.claim: Speculative sampling with a point-mass draft preserves the sampling distribution.
hypotheses_validated.evidence: accept_point_mass empirical frequencies match p (40k draws); end-to-end chi-square vs exact enumerated distribution passes, and a negative control (always-accept) is detected; on the C stub the measured acceptance equals mean p(draft) at T=0.8/0.3/0.05 (0.0127 vs 0.0136, 0.2602 vs 0.2588, 0.6860 vs 0.6860).

hypotheses_validated.claim: Server stays consistent when a streaming client disconnects mid-generation (KV cache and the server's held-token record agree; next request is correct).
hypotheses_validated.evidence: test_server_client_disconnect_mid_stream (RST mid-stream, generation stops early, held == engine KV, follow-up output equals fresh run). Fixed a real race found in review: the Run generator is now closed while the engine gate is held.

test_chat_template_matches_transformers_rendering compares against transformers.utils.chat_template_utils.render_jinja_template (transformers 4.54.1) on a template using trim, strftime_now and bos_token.

hypotheses_falsified.claim: Holding back max(len(stop))-1 characters is an acceptable stop-string strategy.
hypotheses_falsified.evidence: It delayed text that could not start a stop string; replaced by holding back only the longest unsent suffix that is a proper prefix of some stop string (test_text_stream_stop_strings_are_held_back).

open_questions: Does prompt-lookup speculation pay off on real MoE models? Verifying k+1 tokens loads the union of their experts; benefit depends on acceptance vs extra expert bytes. Default is speculative='none' in CLI and server until measured with hearth bench / run --speculative ngram on real weights.
Is hearth_model_info.max_seq the model maximum or the effective KV capacity? Engine.kv_capacity currently re-derives the header rule (requested max_seq, else min(model max_seq, 4096)).
